value.literal: Duke of Gaoguixiang, Zhengyuan year 2, second month, day wuwu: Sparkling Deluder encroached on Eastern Well's northern shaft, the first star at its western end.

value.zh: 占曰：「群臣有家坐罪者。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "Ministers will see their families punished for capital offenses."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Among the ministers, some will have their clans punished for crimes."

value.zh: 甘露元年，諸葛誕族滅。
value.en: In Ganlu 1, Zhuge Dan's entire clan was annihilated.
value.literal: Ganlu year 1, Zhuge Dan's clan was exterminated.

value.zh: 晉武帝泰始四年正月丙戌，彗星見軫，青白色，西北行，又轉東行。
value.en: Emperor Wu of Jin, the fourth year of Taishi, first month, day bingxu: a greenish-white comet appeared in Chariot Shaft, moving northwest before swinging eastward.
value.literal: Jin Emperor Wu, Taishi year 4, first month, day bingxu: a comet appeared in Chariot Shaft, greenish-white, traveling northwest, then turning to travel east.

value.zh: 占曰：「為兵喪。
value.en: Prognostication reads: "War and mourning follow.
value.literal: Prognostication says: "It presages warfare and mourning.

value.zh: 軫又楚分也。」
value.en: Chariot Shaft also marks Chu's domain."
value.literal: Chariot Shaft is also Chu's allotted field."

value.zh: 三月，皇太后王氏崩。
value.en: In the third month Empress Dowager Wang passed away.
value.literal: Third month, Empress Dowager Lady Wang died.

value.zh: 十月，吳將施績寇江夏，萬彧寇襄陽，後將軍田璋、荊州刺史胡烈等破卻之。
value.en: In the tenth month Wu generals Shi Ji attacked Jiangxia and Wan Yu attacked Xiangyang; Rear General Tian Zhang, Jing provincial inspector Hu Lie, and others drove them back.
value.literal: Tenth month, Wu generals Shi Ji raided Jiangxia and Wan Yu raided Xiangyang; Rear General Tian Zhang, Jing Province Inspector Hu Lie, and others defeated and repelled them.

value.zh: 泰始四年七月，星隕如雨，皆西流。
value.en: the fourth year of Taishi, seventh month: stars showered down like rain, all streaking westward.
value.literal: Taishi year 4, seventh month: stars fell like rain, all flowing westward.

value.zh: 占曰：「星隕為民叛，西流，吳民歸晉之象也。」
value.en: Prognostication reads: "A starfall marks popular defection; a westward drift foretells Wu's people submitting to Jin."
value.literal: Prognostication says: "Falling stars signify the people's rebellion; flowing westward is the image of Wu's people returning to Jin."

value.zh: 二年，吳夏口督孫秀率部曲二千餘人來降。
value.en: Two years on Wu's Xiakou garrison commander Sun Xiu brought more than two thousand of his retainers over in surrender.
value.literal: Two years later, Wu's Xiakou supervisor Sun Xiu led more than two thousand of his personal troops in surrender.

value.zh: 吳婦人之修容者，急束其髮，而劘角過于耳。
value.en: Wu women who dressed their hair bound it fiercely and trimmed the corners past the ears.
value.literal: Among Wu women who dressed their appearance, they bound the hair urgently and cut the corners past the ears.

value.zh: 蓋其俗自操束大急，而廉隅失中之謂也。
value.en: Their custom of tight self-restraint overshot the mean of proper conduct.
value.literal: Generally their custom of self-restraint was excessively tight, which is called losing the mean in integrity.

value.zh: 故吳之風俗，相驅以急，言論彈射，以刻薄相尚。
value.en: Wu folk drove one another to urgency, shot verbal barbs in debate, and prized harshness.
value.literal: Therefore Wu's customs drove one another to haste; in speech they shot barbs and honored one another with harshness.

value.zh: 居三年之喪者，往往有致毀以死。
value.en: Mourners in the three-year rites often starved themselves to death.
value.literal: Those in the three-year mourning often brought themselves to ruin by emaciation and died.

value.zh: 諸葛患之，著正交論，雖不可以經訓整亂，蓋亦救時之作也。
value.en: Zhuge Liang, troubled by this, wrote the Discourse on Correct Friendship—not enough to restore order by the classics, yet a timely remedy.
value.literal: Zhuge Liang was troubled by this and wrote the Discourse on Correct Friendship; though it could not set chaos in order by canonical teaching, it was nevertheless a work to rescue the age.

value.zh: 孫休後，衣服之制，上長下短，又積領五六而裳居一二。
value.en: After Sun Xiu, garments grew long above and short below; collars piled five or six deep while the skirt shrank to a fraction.
value.literal: After Sun Xiu, the system of dress was long above and short below, with collars stacked five or six deep while the skirt occupied only one or two parts.

value.zh: 干寶曰：「上饒奢，下儉逼，上有餘下不足之妖也。」
value.en: Gan Bao said: "Extravagance above and meanness below—an omen of plenty on top and want underneath."
value.literal: Gan Bao said: "Luxury above and stinginess below pressing upward—this is the portent of surplus above and insufficiency below."

value.zh: 至孫晧，果奢暴恣情於上，而百姓彫困於下，卒以亡國。
value.en: Under Sun Hao the ruler grew wanton and cruel while the people were ground down, and the state fell.
value.literal: By Sun Hao in the end he was extravagant and violent in feeling above while the common people were carved thin below, and in the end the state perished.

value.zh: 是其應也。
value.en: This was the omen fulfilled.
value.literal: This was the fulfillment.

value.zh: 吳孫休永安五年二月，白虎門北樓災。
value.en: In the second month of the fifth Yong'an year under Sun Xiu of Wu, fire destroyed the north tower of the White Tiger Gate.
value.literal: In the second month of the fifth year of Yong'an under Sun Xiu of Wu, the north tower of the White Tiger Gate burned.

value.zh: 六年十月，石頭小城火，燒西南百八十丈。
value.en: In the tenth month of the sixth year fire swept the small citadel at Shitou, burning one hundred eighty zhang along the southwest.
value.literal: In the tenth month of the sixth year, the small fortress at Shitou burned, consuming one hundred eighty zhang of the southwest quarter.

value.zh: 是時嬖人張布專擅國勢，多行無禮，而韋昭、盛冲終斥不用，兼遣察戰等為使，驚擾州郡，致使交趾反亂。
value.en: At the time the favorite Zhang Bu dominated the government and behaved lawlessly, while Wei Zhao and Sheng Chong were kept from office; he also dispatched Cha Zhan and others as envoys, unsettling the provinces until Jiaozhi rose in revolt.
